name: org.openrewrite.javascript.AddDependency
description: Add an npm dependency to `package.json` and regenerate the lock file natively, without executing the package manager. In a pnpm workspace with catalogs it writes what `pnpm add` writes under the workspace's `catalogMode` and `saveCatalogName`. If the dependency already exists in any scope, the recipe is a no-op. Not safe to use as a precondition: consults the package registry over the network and publishes per-project state shared with other dependency recipes.

name: org.openrewrite.javascript.ChangeDependency
description: Renames an npm dependency in `package.json` and optionally updates its version constraint. A `catalog:` reference keeps its catalog, which gains the new name's entry. After modifying the package.json, the lock file is regenerated natively, without executing the package manager. name: org.openrewrite.javascript.UpgradeDependencyVersion
description: Upgrades the version constraint of matching npm dependencies in `package.json` and regenerates the lock file natively, without executing the package manager. Matching is by exact package name or glob pattern. A version range is replaced whenever it differs from the new one, a `catalog:` reference is upgraded in its catalog entry, and any other value is left as it is. Not safe to use as a precondition: consults the package registry over the network and publishes per-project state shared with other dependency recipes.

name: org.openrewrite.javascript.UpgradeTransitiveDependencyVersion
description: Pins or upgrades a transitive npm dependency with an override at the workspace root, where its package manager reads it, and regenerates the lock file natively, without executing the package manager: npm's `overrides`, Bun's `overrides` or `resolutions`, Yarn's `resolutions`, and for pnpm `pnpm-workspace.yaml` or `pnpm.overrides` by the pnpm release the project names. An override the package manager cannot read is not written, and the reason is recorded. Not safe to use as a precondition: consults the package registry over the network and publishes per-project state shared with other dependency recipes.
